normalized.relation_definition: Designated functional role or label assigned to a specific component within a specified experimental design (e.g., control group, treatment group, baseline).
normalized.direction: component in specified experiment -> its designated role/label in that experiment
normalized.canonical_fact: In an investigation of how phosphates affect oxygen levels in pond water, pond water without phosphates serves as the control group.
normalized.prompt_en: In an investigation testing how phosphates affect oxygen levels in pond water, what role does the pond water without phosphates serve?
evidence_quotes: The pond water without phosphates would be what part of the investigation?
normalized.reason: The source explicitly asks what part of the investigation the phosphate-free pond water represents and answers 'control group.' No existing catalog relation precisely captures the designated role of an experimental component within a specific experiment; 'entity_to_class' implies stable taxonomic membership rather than a functional experimental label. Proposing 'experimental_component_to_role' as a new relation.
